uncovered_constraints_packaged: R10 owns only the CPU-only self-contained visualization/reporting stage and consumes only the exact same-run R01-R09 prefix in workflow01-10-fresh-e2e.
The outer scheduler alone creates the formal R10 Goal; the project skill creates no nested Goal, invokes no Adapt or project skill, and creates no successor.
The pinned target is inspection-bound and immutable; target documentation and historical timings prove source bindings only and cannot populate R10.
The authoritative workload is row zero of the 16-32K dataset with two warmups and eight measured requests at concurrency eight, infinite request rate, and 1024 output tokens.
Every page, track, filter, tooltip, manifest, audit, lineage entry, and handoff retains devices 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, mapping 0-to-0 and 1-to-1, world size two, TP1, PP1, and DP2 mp.
The same-run cumulative ledger and all R01-R09 handoffs, transitive artifacts, run IDs, lineage IDs, request hashes, profile hashes, and topology fields are validated before rendering.
R10 consumes the exact twelve-table R09 manifest and sealed R07/R08 sources; it never rebuilds R09 tables or accepts name-only files.
R07 non-replay time is the sole observed request, process, runtime, queue, and kernel clock through R10; R08 replay timing is diagnostic only.
Observed R07 timing, observed live utilization, replay_projected R08 attributes, derived analysis, and unavailable/unknown evidence remain visibly and textually distinct.

Every R07 live-utilization sample, gap, anchor, uncertainty, availability state, and reason remains visible or queryable without interpolation, resampling, smoothing, imputation, zero fill, or unavailable-as-low claims.
The local viewing design assumes at least 128 GiB and forbids sampling, uniform selection, Top-N, fixed event budgets, hidden tails, lossy bins, or irreversible aggregation.
The full Perfetto count equals request rows plus process rows plus twice kernel rows; each kernel pair shares one exact observed interval and is never counted as two executions or additive duration.

Absolute nanoseconds remain canonical decimal strings, browser positions use integer-safe request-relative offsets, intervals are half-open, ties end before start, and the minimum viewport is no coarser than 1 ns.

The lossless page provides pointer-centered continuous zoom, pan, box/control zoom, reset, at least 100 history states, six full-text filters, fit, exact jumps, complete tracks and overlap lanes, uncapped overlap results, and uncapped viewport listings.

The required overview, lossless timeline, full Perfetto JSON, high-latency hardware view, concurrency/utilization view, index, two acceptance manifests, source-lineage record, and completion audit are all stable, hash-bound outputs.
The single local index and every page are self-contained with inline code/data and no CDN, remote asset, fetch, API, cloud upload, hosted viewer, dynamic install, or network service.

A separate network-denied local browser run proves all required interactions and records zero attempted network requests; missing browser capability yields insufficient evidence rather than a false acceptance.

R06 Perfetto, Plotly, and offline-display capability states are validated; unavailable optional packages require an artifact-local lossless fallback and never justify reduced events or remote dependencies.
High-latency and hardware pages preserve all ties, denominators, joins, units, formulas, capabilities, and unavailable reasons and never claim causality, measured speedup, or predicted speedup.
full_timeline_manifest.json seals R09 and all twelve table hashes, source/event counts, formula, flags, coordinate rules, page/trace hashes, evidence coverage, and lossless utilization accounting.

offline_acceptance_manifest.json seals the presentation payload, navigation, embedded data/code, interactions, network denial, evidence separation, tool provenance, and final evidence decision without self-hashing.

The manifest chain is acyclic: pages and trace precede timeline manifest, browser result precedes offline manifest, which precedes source lineage, completion audit, final artifact manifest, and scheduler handoff.

R10_SOURCE_LINEAGE.json seals every predecessor, input, source anchor, tool, invocation, display transform, stage-source delta, attempt/revision, evidence class, output, and no-device/no-external-execution declaration.

The frozen auditor independently recomputes paths, hashes, row/event conservation, time precision, evidence labels, interactions, self-containment, network denial, and absence of runtime/device/profiler/PMC execution.
Failed and partial builder/browser/auditor attempts are immutable and non-promotable; repairs use new report-repair roots and the same sealed R01-R09 bytes without any predecessor or device rerun.
Known large CPU builders/auditors require two consecutive fully stagnant five-minute observations before only a cmdline-verified scheduler-owned PID may be interrupted.
Business artifacts remain under runtime_artifact_root, the final artifact manifest excludes itself and the scheduler handoff, and the single scheduler handoff remains at runtime_handoff_output.

Execution completion, evidence sufficiency, coverage, explicit unavailability, and authorization remain separate; only complete evidence, full coverage, no remaining authorization, and fresh lineage support terminal acceptance.
The skill and this Adapt handoff are migration products and do not constitute R10, report generation, or performance-workflow execution.
